technical.summary: Mixed technical setup with strong trend structure (hull flip, supertrend, psar) but conflicting momentum indicators (negative MACD, overbought stochrsi, weak volume confirmation) suggest caution on swing entry.

fundamental.summary: ABT shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 77 days—insufficient smart money alignment for actionable signal.

sentiment.summary: No congressional signal; broad market fear (37/100) presents potential contrarian opportunity, but lack of insider conviction and absent news data limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (310.7) with imminent NFP event in 2 days creates severe near-term volatility risk; normal yield curve and flat DXY provide limited offset; earnings in 77 days adds secondary risk layer.

debate.key_bull_argument: Hull flip, supertrend, and PSAR confirm uptrend structure with price above 200-EMA, supported by ADX trending confirmation and force index cross-up.
debate.key_bear_argument: Negative MACD (both 12/26/9 and 8/21/5), overbought stochrsi, weak volume (CMF negative, OBV false), zero fundamental conviction, VIX crisis regime (310.7), imminent NFP volatility, and price below 50-SMA create compounding headwinds that outweigh trend structure.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical trend structure (hull flip, supertrend, PSAR) shows upside momentum, but entry is undermined by negative MACD divergence, overbought stochrsi, and weak volume confirmation that suggest momentum exhaustion rather than conviction.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis regime (310.7) combined with NFP event in 2 days creates severe near-term volatility spike risk that could invalidate trend structure; earnings in 77 days add secondary tail risk.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case; technical, fundamental, sentiment, and risk layers all point to unfavourable risk/reward
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding ABT with 19 open Health Care positions (54% of portfolio) — sector concentration is excessive; skip entry to reduce concentration risk and preserve dry powder for higher-conviction setups.
